description: Measured records behind the benchmark gate-policy decisions of docs/RC_PHASE1_AUDIT_AND_PLAN.md section 11. One entry per decision clause. A change of a recorded value appends a history entry with its measurements and change id; nothing is deleted. Run outputs stay local under out/ (git-ignored); only paths and sha256 values are tracked here.

decisions.title: Light budget (gate G5)
decisions.approval: D11 approved by the user with the plan on 2026-10-15 (Phase-2/3 decision set, recommended options).
decisions.rule: Final light must finish within the budget at the fixed concurrency of 8 jobs x 2 tool threads (run.py --jobs 8; every compile tool runs with 2 threads). Provisionally 1200 s. Frozen in Phase 2 at 1.5 x the slowest final-light wall time measured under that load, and re-measured once in Phase 4 with G2 fixtures and sun. Each change is recorded here and the gate is never loosened afterwards. Under the v1 policy the light stage timeout is 2 x the budget, so over-budget times are measured rather than cut off.

current.next_change: Phase 4: re-measured once with G2 fixtures and sun (plan 8.3). Never loosened afterwards.
current.enforcement: Pass --light-budget 1020 to tools/benchmark/run.py. run.py's DEFAULT_LIGHT_BUDGET and therefore tools/benchmark/rc_benchmark.py (which forbids --light-budget) still use the provisional 1200 s; changing that default changes the runner sha256 and is left to its own change.

history.basis: 1.5 x 790 s, rounded up: q2-tdm-c2 (32 rooms) took 790 s in a Phase-1 solo rerun after hitting the 600 s stage cap under load. It replaced the 600 s cap.

1.5 x 679.491 s = 1019.2365 s, rounded up to the whole second as the provisional value was. 679.491 s is the slowest final-light wall time measured at 8 x 2: q2-tdm-c2 in run B, with all 8 job slots busy for 100% of its light stage.
history.evidence_level: compiler output (ericw-tools 2.0.0-alpha11 light wall time and log; run.py stage timers)

measurements.selection: The 10 slowest BENCH-v1 cases by final-light wall time in the baseline-0 v1-policy summary (out/benchmark-v1/baseline-0/v1-policy, light_budget.slowest_10): q2-tdm-c2, q2-dm-s2, q2-tdm-s1, q2-tdm-c1, q2-duel-c2, q2-duel-s1, q2-tdm-v1, q2-duel-x-parse-2, q2-ctf-s1, q2-duel-s3. All 10 regenerated byte-identical to baseline-0 (.map and .qmg.json).

run_a.what: the 10 cases alone, full compile, run.py --jobs 8, 18:57-19:05 local time
run_a.load_on_slowest: all 8 jobs active for 11.8% of its light stage, only itself for 68.5% (mean 2.46 jobs): the other nine finished within about 150 s. Machine busy share 69.2%; other processes about 6.3 CPUs (Windows Defender 2.2, Claude app 1.1, another project's smoke tests 0.7).
run_a.verdict: Not used for the freeze: it did not measure q2-tdm-c2 under 8 x 2. 1.5 x 417.249 s would give 626 s, which q2-tdm-c2 exceeds under sustained 8 x 2 (679.491 s in run B). Kept as a counterexample.

run_b.what: the same 10 plus 320 filler cases (every non-sealed BENCH-v1 case after q2-tdm-c2 in manifest order, by the fixed rule in out/phase2/changes/x1-light-budget/scripts/select_filler.py; ids in out/benchmark-v1/light-budget/sustained-filler.json), full compile, run.py --jobs 8, 19:06-19:20 local time
run_b.load_on_slowest: all 8 jobs active for 100% of its light stage (8 tool processes 93.7%, 7 for 6.0%). Machine busy share 99.7% of 20 logical CPUs; other processes about 3.8 CPUs (Windows Defender 0.9, Claude app 0.7, another repository's pytest run 0.3, another project's cl.exe/mspdbsrv build 0.3, smoke tests, this lane's load sampler); no foreign compile tool (light, qbsp, vis, q3map2, mbspc, qmg) ran.
run_b.result: 330/330 G3, G4 and G5 pass; 0 light stages over 1020 s; 660/660 output files byte-identical to baseline-0; the only hard-gate difference from baseline-0 is q2-tdm-c2 G5 fail (600 s cap) -> pass.

measurements.machine: 13th Gen Intel Core i7-13700H (14 cores, 20 logical CPUs), 39.7 GB RAM, Windows 11 Home, on AC power, Balanced power scheme. Not idle: other work ran throughout (see load_on_slowest).
measurements.earlier_timings: The recorded baseline-0 times of these inputs (9 from the Phase-1 compile, q2-duel-x-parse-2 from the baseline-0 compile) are 1.4-2.6x run A's; the Phase-1 solo rerun of q2-tdm-c2 took 790 s against 417 s in run A. The load of those runs was not recorded, so the cause is not established. A full run under heavier load than run B's can exceed the budget without any generator change: record the load (out/phase2/changes/x1-light-budget/scripts/load_sampler.ps1) with every budget-gated run.

baseline_resummary.result: G5 409/410 -> 410/410 (q2-tdm-c2, re-run in run A: 417.249 s <= 1020 s); every other gate count unchanged; all hard gates 228 (211 with G10), unchanged because q2-tdm-c2 still fails G2. 0 light stages over 1020 s; slowest recorded light 417.249 s.
